newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Copper in Singapore LME warehouse shipped to China.
newsitem.headline: Copper in Singapore LME warehouse shipped to China.

text.p: Some 6,000 tonnes of copper from the London Metal Exchange (LME) warehouse in Singapore was shipped to China, accounting for the sharp fall in stocks in the city-state, base metal traders said on Friday.
"Somebody took the copper out and shipped the material to China," a European metal trader said, adding the consensus of the trade here was that one company was responsible for the transaction.
Traders said the material was being transported to China to take advantage of better prices there.
"I believe the material is on its way to China. They wanted most of the stuff back," another trader for a metal dealing company said.
The volume of copper in the LME warehouse in Singapore fell 6,175 tonnes to 46,000 tonnes in the LME's stocks report.
